ClipProject.title: ClipProject
ClipProject.description: A user's YouTube or authorized local video clipping project with AI-discovered Shorts suggestions and strategy notes.

sourceType.description: Whether the project references public YouTube metadata or an authorized local video file.

videoId.description: 11-character YouTube video ID or local identifier.

sourceUrl.description: Normalized YouTube URL or local file display identifier.

channelName.description: Creator channel name or Local Studio.

thumbnailUrl.description: Public YouTube thumbnail URL or empty for local videos.

durationSeconds.description: Duration of source video in seconds.

status.description: Current workflow state of the project.

clips.description: Bounded list (max 10) of AI-discovered Short clip segments.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-owned Clipper projects storing metadata, AI clip suggestions, and viral strategy notes.
